description: RDS Cluster Absent From AWS Backup Protected Resource Inventory — Review
rationale: An observed RDS/Aurora cluster ARN was not present in a complete regional AWS Backup protected-resource inventory. Native Aurora/RDS automated backup retention is not evaluated or negated by this finding.
remediation: Verify native DB cluster retention plus independent backup/copy requirements. Where AWS Backup is required, verify resource plan, recovery points and restoration tests.
